newsitem.title: USA: Latin American Casinos says sees good 1997.
newsitem.headline: Latin American Casinos says sees good 1997.

text.p: Latin American Casinos Inc said Monday it projects a small profit for the first and second quarters of 1997, but the third and fourth quarters are expected to reflect increases in revenues and profits.
The company said these third and fourth quarter increases are because of the large income potential of its new gaming venture distributing slot machines on a participation basis.
The company said it has declared a one-time dividend of $0.05 per share to shareholders of record on May 30, 1997. The pay date was not immediately available.
The company said it generated a record profit of $968,000, or $0.29 per share for the year ended December 31, 1996.
The company reported a net loss of $122,168 for the fourth quarter ended Dec. 31. The loss per share was $0.03.

The company said the fourth quarter results were affected by a 200 percent increase in taxes on slot machines imposed by the Peruvian government and an increase in the allowance for doubtful accounts.
